title: Site-wide logo replacement with new image URL

requirements.text: Replace every instance of the TrustFix logo across the entire site — including the Navbar header logo, the HeroSection logo, any white-box logo, any old shield icon logo, and any duplicate logo images — with the single image at https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png. Remove all old logo image references and URLs completely. Do not alter layout, spacing, colors, fonts, header height, or any other visual property. Preserve the existing size proportions and alignment in each section where a logo appears. Do not stretch or distort the new image.

quotes: Replace with ONLY this logo image everywhere: https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png
REMOVE all old logo image references completely.
Use the same size proportion currently used in each section.

acceptanceCriteria: The Navbar header displays only https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png as the logo.
The HeroSection displays only https://i.postimg.cc/52PW5DQj/logo.png as the logo.
No white-box logo, old shield icon, or any previous logo image URL appears anywhere on the page.
All old logo src references are removed from the codebase.
Logo proportions and alignment in each section match the existing layout — no stretching or distortion.
No changes to layout, spacing, colors, fonts, or header height are introduced.

constraints: Do not change layout, spacing, colors, fonts, or header height.
Do not stretch or distort the new logo image.
Only replace logo references — no other modifications.
nonGoals: Redesigning any page section or component.
Changing typography, color palette, or Tailwind config.
